title: ACA s. 18 — Finality of arbitral awards

content.overview: Section 18 requires equal treatment of parties and gives each party a full opportunity to present its case.
content.glance: Section 18 requires equal treatment of parties and gives each party a full opportunity to present its case.
content.study:
Module 1: Equal treatment
The tribunal must treat parties equally; procedural discretion cannot be exercised in a manner that denies equal procedural standing.

Module 2: Full opportunity
Each party must receive a meaningful opportunity to present its case. The standard is procedural fairness, not an entitlement to every requested procedural indulgence.

Module 3: Courtroom application
An alleged procedural irregularity should be analysed by identifying the opportunity denied, its materiality and the statutory consequence available at the appropriate stage.

examples.title: Rule applies
examples.body: Both parties receive notice, access to the material relied upon and a genuine opportunity to respond.

examples.title: Rule fails or changes
examples.body: A tribunal gives one side a material procedural opportunity while denying the other a comparable opportunity without lawful justification.

hypotheticals.analysis: Equal procedural treatment and a full opportunity to present the case, while permitting the tribunal to manage proceedings within the Act.
